issue.body: My test code: ```python from fastapi import FastAPI import uvicorn from staticfiles import StaticFiles app = FastAPI() app.mount("/music", StaticFiles(directory="/home/hanxi/work/xiaomusic/music", follow_symlink=True), name="music") uvicorn.run( app, host=["::", "0.0.0.0"], port=3333, ) ``` The directory /home/hanxi/work/xiaomusic/music is a symlink. ``` > ls -l /home/hanxi/work/xiaomusic/music lrwxrwxrwx 1 hanxi hanxi 26 Apr 30 12:10 /home/hanxi/work/xiaomusic/music -> /home/hanxi/nas/data/music ``` I fix this in https://github.com/hanxi/starlette/commit/831cb5d255832d9f704ffd7be49b4184cd301dd6 Need pr? > [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
